Overview

AWS Services at AtherIQ

AWS gives you a service for almost every requirement, which is both the advantage and the trap. Projects go wrong when the architecture uses fifteen services where four would do, or when IAM and networking are treated as something to tidy up later.

We design AWS environments around the workload: compute sized to real traffic, managed databases rather than self-run instances where it makes sense, and serverless for work that is genuinely event-driven.

Security and cost controls go in from the beginning — least-privilege IAM, private subnets, encryption, tagging and budget alerts — because retrofitting them across a live estate is considerably more expensive.

Talk it through first

Bring the problem rather than a specification. We will tell you what the work involves, where the risk sits and roughly what it costs before you commit to anything.

What we provide

Included in This Service

The concrete deliverables. Where something is out of scope for your budget, we say so before the quotation rather than after.

Compute & hosting

EC2, ECS and Elastic Beanstalk for containerised and traditional applications, with autoscaling and load balancing.

Serverless applications

Lambda functions behind API Gateway for event-driven processing, scheduled jobs and integration endpoints.

Databases & storage

RDS for PostgreSQL, MySQL and SQL Server, DynamoDB for high-throughput key-value workloads, S3 for object storage and static assets.

Content delivery & networking

CloudFront distributions, Route 53 DNS, VPC design with public and private subnets, security groups and gateways.

Identity & security

Least-privilege IAM roles and policies, Secrets Manager, KMS encryption, CloudTrail auditing and GuardDuty monitoring.

Monitoring & operations

CloudWatch metrics, logs, dashboards and alarms, plus deployment automation through CodePipeline or GitHub Actions.

Business benefits

Why It Matters Commercially

Outcomes rather than a restatement of the feature list.

Scales with traffic, not with guesswork

Autoscaling groups and serverless components absorb spikes without provisioning for the annual peak year-round.

Global delivery

CloudFront puts static assets and cached responses close to users, cutting load times for distributed audiences.

Least privilege by default

IAM roles scoped to what each component needs limits the blast radius when something is compromised.

Costs attributed properly

Tagging and budget alerts show which application, environment or team is generating spend.

Questions

Frequently Asked Questions

Do you provide AWS services?

Yes. We design, deploy and support applications on AWS using EC2, ECS, Lambda, RDS, S3, API Gateway, CloudFront and the supporting networking, identity and monitoring services.

Can you migrate an application from another host to AWS?

Yes. We assess the application, plan the target architecture, migrate the data with a tested cutover, and keep the previous environment available until the new one has proved itself.

Can you reduce our existing AWS bill?

Frequently. Common wins are oversized instances, unattached storage, missing lifecycle policies on S3, idle non-production environments and on-demand pricing where reserved or savings plans would apply. We start with a review before recommending changes.

Do you use infrastructure as code?

Yes. Environments are defined in Terraform or CloudFormation so they can be rebuilt reliably, reviewed like application code and kept consistent between staging and production.

Ready to scope it?

Send us what you have — a brief, a wireframe, a spreadsheet of the current process, or just a description of what is not working.
